notes.title: Bounce Trials - Minor Patch - Restart Key!
notes.notes:
Thanks to player feedback this patch introduces the [b]Restart key[/b], using 'R' on the keyboard or Y/Triangle on a gamepad the current level will now restart. This saves players from having to access the menu via Pause and selecting Restart.

Many thanks to feedback from @Scoot for this suggestion.

This patch also includes fixes for the Silver and Bronze reward times on Level 008.

Thank you so much for playing and your support! Please do keep the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1854400/discussions/0/3827551537100690524/]feedback[/url] coming!

notes.title: Bounce Trials - Minor Patch - New Version 1.0.3
notes.notes:
[h1]Minor Patch introduces version 1.0.3[/h1]

This patch addresses one in-game issues that was previously patched but not fully fixed:

[list]
[*] Vertically moving platforms should now prevent player from passing through when they land on the moving platform without enough inertia.
[/list]

Many thanks to @nana who reported the issue!

Please continue to provide [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1854400/discussions/0/3827551537100690524/][b]feedback[/b][/url] or highlight any [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1854400/discussions/0/3827551537100695883/][b]issues or bugs[/b][/url].

notes.title: Bounce Trials - Minor Patch - New Version 1.0.2
notes.notes:
[h1]Minor Patch introduces version 1.0.2[/h1]

After initial feedback, this patch addresses two in-game issues:

[list]
[*] Moving platforms now reset their position when 'Restarting' the level.
[*] The award times for Bronze and Silver on Level 009 have been corrected, where they were previously lower than Gold award time.
[/list]

Many thanks to @nana and @driftee who reported these issues so soon after release!!

Please continue to provide [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1854400/discussions/0/3827551537100690524/][b]feedback[/b][/url] or highlight any [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1854400/discussions/0/3827551537100695883/][b]issues or bugs[/b][/url].

notes.title: Bounce Trials - Minor Patch - New Version 1.0.1
notes.notes:
[h1]Minor Patch introduces version 1.0.1[/h1]

After initial feedback, this patch addresses two in-game issues:

[list]
[*] Camera speed on the horizontal axis has been increased for ball-following, particularly to address the difficulty with the jump/flip pad on level 29.
[*] Vertically ascending platforms now provide additional 'bounce' to prevent players falling through the platform when previously losing momentum.
[/list]

Many thanks to @driftee who reported these issues so soon after release!!

Please continue to provide [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1854400/discussions/0/3827551537100690524/][b]feedback[/b][/url] or highlight any [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1854400/discussions/0/3827551537100695883/][b]issues or bugs[/b][/url].

notes.title: Bounce Trials - Now Available to Download!
notes.notes:
[h1]Bounce Trials - Release Day[/h1]

[b]Today, 15th September 2023, is an exciting day for ProperSerious with the launch of their first Steam game - Bounce Trials.[/b]

Bounce Trials is a completely [b]free game[/b] - no microtransactions, no fees, no subscriptions, no in-game store - entirely free, and it's [b]available to download and play now[/b]!

In Bounce Trials you play as a perpetually bouncing ball, which you can only control by moving to the left or right. You need to time your movements perfectly and move precisely to overcome the hurdles to reaching your goal. Timing (and a bit of patience) is key.

There is one goal in every level, and as long as you reach it you pass the level, but do it in good time and you'll be awarded a Gold, Silver, or Bronze reward. There are platforms of all sizes to get to, spikes to bounce over, moving platforms to stay on, and flip boards that propel you.

[b]Let's not delay you any further; download and play Bounce Trials today![/b]

notes.title: Bounce Trials - Release Date Confirmed
notes.notes:
[h1]Bounce Trials Ready for Release[/h1]

Hello and welcome!

Bounce Trials is ready for release and is waiting for the two weeks store presence requirement to pass before it can go live. That means the earliest Bounce Trials can go live is Friday the 15th of September 2023. On that day at around 9am BST, Bounce Trials will be released, ready to download and play!

Remember, Bounce Trials is an entirely Free game - there's a possibility for further development depending on demand.

While you wait you can add it to your Wishlist!

[h2]Bounce Trials Release Date[/h2]
[b]Friday the 15th of September 2023 at 9 A.M. BST[/b]
